title: DeathChestPro
description: Simple death chest plugin! Drop all of your items onto a chest when died.
body:
# DeathChestPro

A Paper Minecraft plugin that creates chests at player death locations, allowing you to safely recover your items without losing them forever.

## Features

🪦 **Death Chest Creation** - Automatically creates a chest at the location where you die, storing all your items safely.

🌌 **Void Fall Recovery** - Died in the void? Your items are safely stored in The End at Y=100 instead of being lost forever.

🖱️ **Easy Item Retrieval** - Right-click on your death chest to open it and recover your items.

⚙️ **Configurable** - Toggle death chest functionality on/off via settings.

## Requirements

- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.11+
- **Server Type**: Paper (Spigot fork)

## Installation

1. Download the plugin jar file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins/` directory
3. Restart your server
4. Configure settings in `plugins/DeathChestPro/settings.yml` if needed
